useDefaultFcsUrls.title: Use bundled FCS roster URL dataset
useDefaultFcsUrls.description: When enabled, the Actor uses the bundled 2025 FCS roster URL list as the demo/default source set. Add startUrls below to merge custom URLs into the run.

startUrls.title: Additional roster URLs
startUrls.description: Optional additional college football roster page URLs. Each item can include userData.team_name.

season.title: Season label
season.description: Optional season value to place on each result. If blank, the Actor tries to infer it from /roster/2025-style URLs.

sport.title: Sport label
sport.description: Output label. Keep as football for this Actor unless adapting the selectors for another sport.

maxRosterUrls.title: Max roster URLs
maxRosterUrls.description: Safety cap for the number of roster pages to crawl. Set to 0 to run the full bundled/default list.

maxPlayersPerTeam.title: Max players per team
maxPlayersPerTeam.description: Optional cap per roster page. Set to 0 for no cap.

adapterMode.title: Adapter mode
adapterMode.description: Auto runs the platform/domain adapters plus safe fallbacks. Use a specific adapter only for debugging a problem domain.

emitDiagnosticRows.title: Emit diagnostic rows for zero-player pages
emitDiagnosticRows.description: When enabled, pages with no extracted players add a visible diagnostic row to the dataset. Detailed diagnostics are always saved in ZERO_PLAYER_PAGES and RUN_SUMMARY key-value records.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many roster pages to fetch in parallel. Keep moderate for school athletics sites.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Number of retries for failed roster page requests.

requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.title: Request handler timeout seconds
requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.description: How long to allow extraction from each roster page before timing out.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout seconds
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each page HTTP response.

useSessionPool.title: Use session pool
useSessionPool.description: Keep enabled for more stable crawling across many athletics domains.

respectRobotsTxtFile.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxtFile.description: Enable this if you want the crawler to obey robots.txt for each domain. You should still review source-site terms before commercial reuse.
